description_summary: Use when investigating TypeScript starter patterns or evaluating npm packages against official sources and resolved versions.
should_trigger: Research official guidance for this TypeScript package design decision.
Compare upstream approaches using primary sources and our locked versions.
Investigate whether this library supports the behavior we need.
Write an evidence-backed research note about Node lifecycle handling.
Research a Fastify integration tradeoff before we choose an implementation.
should_trigger_test: Separate upstream facts from inferences in the research result.
Compare alternatives without installing another framework into the starter.
should_not_trigger: Execute the tasks in this existing implementation plan.
Fix this typo in one mobile component with a contained edit.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
